locator.title: В каких банках можно выгодно купить доллар?
locator.lead: Хотите купить/продать доллар выгодно? Смотрите курсы на Банки.ру!

nearest_text_before.text: Чтобы вам было легче найти, в каких банках сейчас выгодный курс, переходите на сайт Банки.ру!

nearest_text_after.text: Переходите по ссылке, выбирайте предложение, которое вам подходит и нажимайте кнопку "подробнее" — появится список отделений банка с адресами.

image_reading: A smiling couple is shown mid-walk, looking at each other while each holds an ice-cream cone upright; large glowing currency-like discs float around them against a city backdrop.
Their relaxed expressions, wind-touched hair and forward-facing bodies imply gentle ongoing movement, while the cones provide clear hand-held anchors that should remain stable.
analysis.article_context: The body image supports the article’s practical message that comparing dollar exchange offers can make an everyday purchase—and the lifestyle or travel it enables—feel easy, positive, and rewarding.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Finding a favorable dollar exchange offer can support enjoyable plans with a sense of ease and confidence.
structured_intent.initial_state: The smiling couple is side by side in a forward-walking posture, looking at each other and holding ice-cream cones upright.
structured_intent.primary_action: They continue walking forward together at a relaxed pace.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The couple has advanced visibly forward while still looking at each other and holding both cones upright.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: Each ice-cream cone remains upright and visibly held in the same person’s hand.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Their cheerful, mutually engaged mood remains unchanged through the last frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, use a fixed camera as the couple continues a relaxed forward walk with moderate, steady motion. Their torsos and hair respond naturally to the steps while both cones remain upright and continuously visible; they finish noticeably closer to the camera, still sharing the same warm gaze.
models.positive_prompt: The couple walks forward together at a relaxed, even pace, with gentle natural body sway and the ice-cream cones held upright in their hands. By the final frames they have moved visibly closer while still smiling at each other.

models.scene_plan: Fill the five-second shot with an unhurried shared stroll toward the viewer, using a gentle backward camera track focused on the couple so their apparent scale changes only slightly. Let the walking rhythm develop evenly and settle near the end with both cones stable and their cheerful mutual attention unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: The couple continues strolling toward the camera in one smooth, relaxed motion, keeping both ice-cream cones upright. They end a little closer together and nearer the viewer, still smiling at each other.

models.scene_plan: For four seconds, begin an immediate, smooth backward track centered on the couple while they walk forward at normal real-time speed. Keep the travel clear but restrained, with continuous natural step motion; end after visible forward progress through the plaza, preserving the upright cones and their shared happy gaze.
models.positive_prompt: Track backward smoothly as the couple walks forward together at a natural pace, their hair and clothing moving gently while each cone stays upright. By the end they have advanced visibly through the plaza and remain smiling at each other.
